features: Solar-powered bi-spectrum thermal camera kit with 80 W photovoltaic panel and 30 Ah lithium battery
thermal module: 256x192 VOx uncooled, 12 um pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 40 mK, thermal FOV 50.0 x 37.3, digital zoom x2/x4
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 4.3 mm lens, FOV 84 x 43.1, 120 dB WDR
bi-spectrum image fusion (optical detail overlaid on thermal), target coloration (white/black hot)
temperature exception alarm for fire prevention, measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/-8 C, 21 rules (10 points, 10 areas, 1 line)
VCA: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exit (up to 8 rules), vehicle/human classification
IR supplement up to 30 m and white-light up to 30 m
IK10 housing, TVS 4000V lightning protection, wind resistance level 12
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TXS2628-3P is a solar-powered, 4G-connected bi-spectrum thermal camera kit built for off-grid fire prevention and perimeter monitoring on construction sites, farms and towers. Its 256x192 thermal module measures temperature (-20 to 150 C) and triggers audible and strobe alarms on VCA or temperature events.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80, Profile S/G). Thermal + optical exposed as separate channels.
